faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIPS Project Manager position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 09 August 2026. It is advisable to send your application well in advance of the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Manager post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's Degree in Population Studies, Bio Statistics, Public Health, or Economics. Additionally, they need to have 3 years of experience working with large-scale data and at least one published paper in a peer-reviewed journal.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Manager role?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Project Manager position is 35 years. There is no minimum age specified in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Manager position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Manager post will receive a maximum salary of Rs. 60,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the IIPS Project Manager recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your CV and relevant documents to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is this a permanent or contract job?
faq.answer: The Project Manager position is on a contract basis for an initial period of 3 months, which is extendable.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies for the Project Manager post?
faq.answer: There is only one vacancy for the Project Manager post announced by IIPS.

faq.question: Q8. Are there any application fees for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Based on the provided information, there is no mention of any application fee for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I attach with my application?
faq.answer: You should attach self-attested copies of all required documents, including educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q10. When will the interviews be conducted?
faq.answer: The interviews for the Project Manager position are scheduled to be conducted on 10 August 2026.
